invariants.statement: Each subscribed message resolves to exactly one content-addressed per-role disposition before model execution.
Role and handler resources remain bound across execution and compaction.
Handler output proposes only transitions declared by the current acyclic workflow node.
An idle change-stream timeout creates no organizational work and invokes no model.
Changing message type, role, actor, alias, or thread cannot bypass node identity or root authority.
Duplicate delivery creates at most one admission and one invocation, and legacy string handlers remain readable only through the bounded compatibility path.
